name: coiled-coil domain containing 6
pathways: positive regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolic process

function.text: CCDC6 encodes coiled-coil domain-containing protein 6. Annotated molecular activities include protein complex scaffold activity and structural constituent of cytoskeleton. It participates in positive regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma; Papillary thyroid carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
